problem: The production NL/EN browser proof could find language controls in the DOM but no visible mobile select in the active navigation drawer.
root_cause: The i18n runtime mounted a mobile language control into only one discovered mobile root. Pages can contain both a shared/hidden mobile root and the active legacy #bgkopMob drawer, so the control could be mounted exclusively into a hidden host.
prevention: Mount the mobile language control idempotently into every real mobile navigation host, deduplicated by DOM identity.
Never assume the first mobile root is the active visible navigation surface.
Production locale proof must use a visible control and verify NL to EN to NL state changes.
The central locale runtime must be proven on homepage, pricing and systems-koppelingen before LIVE.

evidence.failure: visible mobile language select is missing
